{{Top|leg}}
'''Kael''' was a mysterious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] working for the [[Mantis Syndicate]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Kael's [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Gender/Legends|sex]] and physical aspect were unknown.

Circa [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the Syndicate sent Kael to murder [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and member of the smuggling organization [[Black Bha'lir]] operating in Socorro. Kael was to approach Ancher during the funeral of another smuggler, an event that would be witnessed by hundreds of people. [[The Tribunal]], leaders of the Bha'lir, discovered the plot but were still unaware of Kael's description. They assigned a small group the task to stop Kael, without Ancher even knowing he was in danger.
